summary: Sound and voice night: our Shorts run 12 effects a minute where the biggest AI-voiced 3D outliers run 20-30, so I queued a look test with denser machine sound; and the pace fix lands at 140-148 words a minute, not the 164 it aimed for, so I asked the improver to check. Added two topics: how a bathroom safety outlet trips, and how a nuclear pellet becomes power.
why: AI Tech 3.7's dam Short (8.6M on 11K subscribers) ~20 effects a minute, Inside Decoded 30-32, ours capped at 12. Transistor 148, Crossrail 140, mobile phone 148 words a minute after the speed change. Outlet reference: 77.3M views in 31 days; nuclear reference 672K in 4 days on a 36K channel.

findings.title: Denser machine sound in the biggest outliers
findings.detail: 20-32 effects a minute in AI Tech 3.7 and Inside Decoded Shorts against our cap of 12; Branch Education 8-12. Low confidence (counted by eye).

findings.title: The pace fix fell short
findings.detail: Three Shorts since the voice went to 1.0 speak 140-148 words a minute, not about 164; likely beat padding.

findings.title: Third curve, same drop
findings.detail: The transistor Short lost 24.5 points at 6.2 s on a re-asked question line; all three curves lose most at 6-8 s on a line that isn't the mechanism.

findings.title: No recent event worth a long video
findings.detail: Microsoft 365 outage (12-14 Nov): no 100K+ explainer found and no published root cause.

changes.title: Look challenger tech-sfx-dense
changes.detail: 20 machine effects a minute on the test side vs 12; judged on held after the hook.

changes.title: Proposal tech-wpm-gap
changes.detail: Find why the pace fix lands at 140-148 words a minute.

changes.title: 2 topics
changes.detail: GFCI outlet (gadget_inside, high) and nuclear pellet to power (machine_works).
